title: Comparison of Cech completion with the constructed quotient Roos cone
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative Noetherian ring, J an ideal and U a coefficient-sized pro-etale object. Write R for the completed coefficient ring on the slice and q_0 for its residue projection [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. Let K -> R[0] be any augmented complex with the local extended Cech description for ker(q_0) [def-weil-pbc-local-extended-cech-description], and M any object of D(R). Then RHom(K,M) is the point of a homotopy-limit cone over the specific adjoint quotient tower of [lem-sfb-adic-residue-adjoint-tower]. Its n-th leg composed after the actual Cech completion unit equals the normalized scalar unit adj_n.unit(M). No completeness, boundedness, perfectness, or constructibility hypothesis on M is made.

source.place: Tag 099M, proof of lemma-naive-completion; Algebraization Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul; Cohomology on Sites Tags 0940 and 0941.

proof.text: The kernel inclusion is monic and its module is finite type. Apply the Cech reflector properties to the given augmented K. For each finite quotient object, restrict a complex representative and use the complete-elements ideal: the sectionwise residue kernel is spanned by images of J, whose (n+1)-st powers vanish in the nth quotient. The scalar-restriction section-completeness criterion and the nilpotent localization argument prove completeness of every quotient term.

A reflector complete locus is closed under existing products: uniquely factor each projection through its unit, assemble a retraction, and use injectivity of the mapping bijection for the other inverse identity. Exact derived restriction followed by internal Hom from each local section localization carries the Roos triangle to a distinguished triangle with zero second and third objects. Thus every Roos cone point of the quotient tower is complete.

Countable products in the derived category exist by the proved source-library instance DerivedCategory.hasLimitsOfShape_discrete (WeilConjectures.Algebra.Homology.HomotopyCategory.Products), specialized in one line using the Grothendieck property of module sheaves. Complete one minus the tower shift to obtain a Roos cone c. Its Milnor Hom map is surjective by coyoneda exactness and the product universal property. Apply it to the already compatible scalar units to obtain a:M -> c.pt with the required legs. The mapping-property theorem for this normalized unit supplies universality into every complete object.

Use the Cech mapping bijection to factor a through the Cech unit, obtaining f:Cech(M) -> c.pt. Use the quotient-unit mapping bijection to factor the Cech unit in the reverse direction, obtaining g. Completeness proved above makes both applications valid; injectivity gives fg=id and gf=id. Transport c along this explicit isomorphism. Associativity, the factorization equation and the normalized-unit leg equations give the stated equation for every n.

theorem adicResidue_cech_quotient_cone
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (J : Ideal A) (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (M : AdicResidueLocalDerived.{u, v} X J U)
    (K : ringedSiteComplex
      ((completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U))
    (ε : K ⟶ ringedSiteRingComplex
      ((completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U))
    (hK : HasLocalExtendedCechDescription
      ((completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U)
      (kernelIdeal (adicResidueLocalProjection.{u, v} X J U 0)).module
      (kernelIdeal (adicResidueLocalProjection.{u, v} X J U 0)).inclusion K ε) :
    ∃ π : (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj
        ((ringedCechCompletionFunctor
          ((completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U) K).obj M) ⟶
        adicResidueAdjointTower.{u, v} X J U M,
      Pretriangulated.IsHomotopyLimit ⟨_, π⟩ ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, ringedCechCompletionUnit
          ((completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U) K ε M ≫
          π.app (op n) = (adicResidueScalarAdjunction.{u, v} X J U n).unit.app M
